preamble: Click loss: a voiced lateral click [ɡǁ] loses its anterior closure and leaves the velar [g]. Only one form is cited, so certainty is 2. In Ndau (Shona cluster, Zimbabwe/Mozambique), clicks are marginal and enter mainly through Zulu loanwords. Borland (1970), cited by Sands & Gunnink (2019), records click words alternating with velar non-clicks, as well as lateral clicks alternating with dental and alveolar ones. This is the same front-closure loss as in Fwe (see click_dental_to_g), here in a language beyond the fringe of the Kalahari Basin area.
phoneticEffects: Click Loss, Deletion Of Front Closure
